appearances.snippet: I found it curious that the UVU Independent Review declined to name him. It was a curious omission for a couple of reasons, foremost because he's a public figure. ... Doesn't just get to say, if you thought, 'Oh, maybe he just said, I don't want to be named, please, like, to keep my privacy.' You don't get, that's not an option. I'm sorry, you're a public figure. Also, the review chose to name people who didn't even want to participate in the review at all. They named Caleb Jilkut (UVU Turning Point USA chapter president; transcript name spelling unverified), the Turning Point USA, uh, local chapter president at UVU. They named Macy Crofts (headquarters staff member; transcript name spelling unverified) over at headquarters. They didn't care.
